CHAOS 皮克斯风格 多比例

轻松将您的肖像照片转变为令人惊叹的皮克斯动画风格，并从 7 种经典长宽比中自由选择，以创建独特的个性化艺术作品！

核心特点：

标志性皮克斯风格转变：利用精心调校的皮克斯风格LORA模型，瞬间为您的人像照片赋予生动俏皮的动画质感，仿佛直接从经典动画电影中走出来一样。

7种宽高比任你选择：提供7种常见的宽高比方案，满足您不同场景的显示需求：

方案0：1：1（经典方形，适合社交媒体头像、帖子）

方案一：16:9（宽屏，适合视频缩略图、横屏显示）

方案二：4:3（传统显示比例）

方案3：1:2（竖排长图，适合故事，部分移动展示）

方案4：2:1（影院宽幅格式）

方案5：3:4（垂直，适合人像特写，一些社交媒体）

方案六：9:16（竖屏，适合短视频、手机壁纸）

智能画布扩展：当您选择的宽高比大于原始照片的画布时，工作流程将自动执行智能外画，确保风格一致性和图像内容的自然扩展。

可自定义图像高度：默认输出图像高度为 1024 像素（宽度根据所选宽高比自动计算）。您也可以根据需要调整该参数，以获得不同尺寸和分辨率的图像。

使用方法：

上传照片：单击上传按钮并选择要转换的肖像照片。为了获得最佳效果，请使用清晰、光线充足的正面或半身照片。

选择宽高比：从提供的 7 个方案中选择您喜欢的比例（输入方案编号 0-6）。

调整参数（可选）：如有必要，您可以调整默认图像生成高度。

单击“运行”：确认设置后，单击“运行”按钮。

等待一代：请稍等片刻，CHAOS PixarStyle MultiRatio 将为您精心打造风格独特的动画杰作！

友情提醒和支持：

生成效果会受到原始照片质量、人的姿势和背景复杂程度的影响。

随意尝试不同的照片和长宽比组合，发现更多创意乐趣！

我们致力于不断优化我们的模型和功能。敬请期待更多惊喜！

如需帮助或疑问，请加入我们的免费QQ群：247228975

CHAOS PixarStyle MultiRatio

Easily transform your portrait photos into an awesome Pixar animation style and freely choose from 7 classic aspect ratios to create unique, personalized artwork!

Core Features:

Iconic Pixar Style Transformation: Utilizes a finely-tuned Pixar style LORA model to instantly give your portrait photos a vivid and playful animated texture, as if they came straight out of a classic animated movie.

7 Aspect Ratios at Your Choice: Offers 7 common aspect ratio schemes to meet your display needs across different scenarios:

Scheme 0: 1:1 (Classic square, ideal for social media avatars, posts)

Scheme 1: 16:9 (Widescreen, suitable for video thumbnails, landscape displays)

Scheme 2: 4:3 (Traditional display ratio)

Scheme 3: 1:2 (Vertical long image, good for stories, some mobile displays)

Scheme 4: 2:1 (Cinematic wide format)

Scheme 5: 3:4 (Vertical, suitable for portrait close-ups, some social media)

Scheme 6: 9:16 (Portrait screen, ideal for short videos, mobile wallpapers)

Smart Canvas Expansion: When your selected aspect ratio is larger than the original photo's canvas, the workflow will automatically perform smart outpainting, ensuring style consistency and natural extension of the image content.

Customizable Image Height: The default output image height is 1024 pixels (width is automatically calculated based on the selected aspect ratio). You can also adjust this parameter as needed to obtain images of different sizes and resolutions.

How to Use:

Upload Photo: Click the upload button and select a portrait photo you want to transform. For best results, use clear, well-lit frontal or half-body shots.

Select Aspect Ratio: Choose your preferred ratio from the 7 provided schemes (input scheme number 0-6).

Adjust Parameters (Optional): If necessary, you can adjust the default image generation height.

Click Run: After confirming your settings, click the "Run" button.

Wait for Generation: Please wait a moment while CHAOS PixarStyle MultiRatio meticulously crafts your uniquely styled animated masterpiece!

Friendly Reminders & Support:

The generation effect can be influenced by the quality of the original photo, a person's posture, and background complexity.

Feel free to experiment with different photos and aspect ratio combinations to discover more creative fun!

We are committed to continuously optimizing our models and features. Stay tuned for more surprises!

For assistance or questions, please join our free QQ Group: 247228975
